subject: SIG artifacts: pre-audit reconciliation & remediation log
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tharris@novacorp.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novacorp.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG kickoff + artifact list for upcoming vendor review

Stephanie —

Thanks for taking this on. NovaCorp is starting a compressed vendor security review next month and we need the completed SIG questionnaire plus supporting artifacts (SOC 2 report, pen test summary, ISO statements, security deck). Can you confirm what you will provide and approximate delivery dates?

Key asks:
- Completed SIG spreadsheet (preferably marked where answers reference artifacts)
- SOC 2 Type II report (2026)
- Pen test executive summary and remediation status (most recent)
- ISO statements or attestation
- High-level security deck for executive reviewers

We expect to share these with our procurement and information security teams. If there are parts that require redaction or an NDAs, flag them.

Appreciate a short plan.

Tom
Security Manager, NovaCorp
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@novacorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff + artifact list for upcoming vendor review

Tom —

Thanks for the note. Outline below is what we can deliver and owners on our side. We're aiming to have the deliverables ready for your initial review by 2027-07-12, with the SOC 2 and pen-test attached and the SIG annotated. If you need items earlier, tell me which ones and we'll prioritize.

Deliverable plan (owners):
- Completed SIG spreadsheet, annotated with artifact references — Stephanie Nguyen (I will drive) — target 2027-07-12
- SOC 2 Type II (2026) — Priyom Das — attached on or before 2027-07-12
- Pen test executive summary + remediation log — Karthik Iyer — attached; remediation status noted
- ISO statements/attestation PDF — Priyom Das — attached
- Security deck (executive summary) — Stephanie Nguyen — attached PPTX

Attachments will be shared as a secure Drive folder and we'll send a DocuSign access link if you require the official report copy. If NovaCorp needs a redacted SOC 2, mention the fields to redact and we'll produce one.

Next steps: I will upload artifacts to a secure Drive folder and share the link by 2027-07-08. Full package to follow by 2027-07-12.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff + artifact list for upcoming vendor review

Team —

Attaching the pen test executive summary and the remediation log (see attachment stubs below). Key notes:
- Pen test completed 2027-06-10. No critical findings; 2 high, 7 medium, 5 low. Highs were addressed within 30 days.
- Remediation status: High -> closed; Medium -> 80% closed; Low -> 100% closed.
- We have a short internal write-up mapping each SIG control to the pen-test artifacts.

Attachment stubs: PenTest_Summary_2027-06.pdf (exec summary), PenTest_Remediation_Log_2027.xlsx

I'll upload these to the shared Drive folder Stephanie creates. Let me know if NovaCorp needs the full report (we can provide under NDA/DSC).

-Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@novacorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverables: SIG spreadsheet + artifact folder (drive link included)

Tom —

Per our plan, I've uploaded the initial package to a secure folder for NovaCorp review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sig-artifacts

Included in the folder (attachment stubs listed here):
- Redwood_SIG_Answers_annotated.xlsx (SIG answers with references to supporting artifacts)
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf
- PenTest_Summary_2027-06.pdf
- PenTest_Remediation_Log_2027.xlsx
- ISO_27001_Statement.pdf
- Security_Deck_Q2_2027.pptx

Notes / redaction: We provided the SOC 2 report with only operational-level details visible; if you require a fully redacted version for procurement, tell us which sections to mask and we'll produce one via DocuSign access (link below).

DocuSign copy (for auditor-only access): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?uid=ABC123

If NovaCorp wants an annotated mapping of SIG control IDs to page/section in the SOC 2 report, we can supply that as a separate CSV — Priyom can produce this by 2027-07-14 if needed.

-Stephanie
From: Tom Harris <tharris@novacorp.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverables: SIG spreadsheet + artifact folder (drive link included)

Stephanie —

Received the folder and attachments — thanks. Quick follow-ups from our security review:
1) Can you provide the SOC 2 mapping CSV (SIG control -> SOC 2 page/section)? That will speed our procurement review.
2) For two medium pen-test items we requested a brief note describing the mitigation timeline; can Karthik add a 2-3 line summary per item?
3) Minor ask on the security deck: please add a single slide with network isolation diagram (high level).

If you can get items 1-3 by 2027-07-16, we should be able to finish our internal review and move to contract. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom
Security Manager, NovaCorp
